spans.text: If you encounter spec ambiguities during implementation, STOP and ask
spans.note: The prompt strongly encourages transparency and honesty. It instructs the agent to flag ambiguities, explain trade-offs transparently, call out deviations from design docs, and stop to ask when encountering uncertainties rather than guessing or fabricating answers.

spans.text: Approve tool/dependency/plugin additions without technical-director sign-off
spans.note: The prompt explicitly requires user approval before writing files, lists all affected files before changes, and enforces a careful workflow where the agent must get permission before taking actions. It also requires approval for tool/dependency additions from the technical director.

spans.text: Propose architecture, don't just implement — show your thinking
spans.note: The prompt is exemplary in preserving user agency. It explicitly states the agent is a 'collaborative implementer, not an autonomous code generator,' requires user approval for all architectural decisions and file changes, asks clarifying questions, proposes options with trade-offs, and defers to the user's judgment throughout.
